notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.
τὸν ἐπίσκοπον is the expressed accusative subject of the infinitive, so no rule 74 supplied subject is in question here; δεῖ takes a bare *must* and εἶναι the lexical *be*.
ἀνεπίλημπτον → *without reproach* heads on *reproach* under rule 84, which is settled thirteen units to none.
σώφρονα → *sober minded* heads on *sober*, rule 91 naming this very lexeme family and the corpus spending *sober*/*soberly* on σωφρ- and *mind* on none of it.
διδακτικόν → *apt to teach* heads on *teach* by rule 91's family query, *apt* answering only to the -ικος suffix; a head on *apt* is the competing reading and is named in the note.
μιᾶς γυναικός → *of one wife* keeps *of* on the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause, discontinuous under rule 15; ἄνδρα is anarthrous, so its supplied *the* is a rule 51 helper on the noun.
